recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中在淡粉紅色的纖維素樣背景裡，組織球的細胞質內（箭頭）塞滿許多帶透明暈的小圓點狀微生物，形成鬆散的肉芽腫性組織球浸潤，符合組織漿菌感染。
features: Loose aggregate of histiocytes within a pale eosinophilic, fibrinous background
Histiocytes with foamy cytoplasm containing numerous tiny round organisms with clear halos (arrow)
Absence of well-formed epithelioid granuloma or giant cells
Scattered lymphocytes, plasma cells and erythroid precursors at the periphery
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a poorly formed histiocytic infiltrate within a pale eosinophilic fibrinous background. Several histiocytes contain numerous small, uniform, round intracytoplasmic organisms with surrounding clear halos (arrow), measuring approximately 2–4 µm. Well-formed epithelioid granulomas and giant cells are not seen, and scattered lymphocytes, plasma cells and erythroid precursors are present at the periphery. Findings are consistent with a loose granulomatous response to intracellular yeasts, suggestive of disseminated histoplasmosis; confirmation with GMS/PAS stains and culture is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes are similar in size but show a kinetoplast, are GMS negative and may be CD1a positive, whereas Histoplasma is GMS and PAS positive.
MAC produces foamy histiocytes with striated cytoplasm filled with acid-fast bacilli rather than discrete haloed yeasts.
Cryptococcus yeasts are larger and more variable with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule.
Gelatinous transformation shows amorphous pale extracellular material without histiocytes laden with organisms.
